chunks.content: # CLO 2026.0 - 3D Line Drawing Pen This document details the new 3D draft pen virtual model function in CLO 2026.0, focusing on how to create, edit, and convert 3D line drafts directly on virtual models. It covers tool selection, drawing techniques, symmetry options, view controls, error correction, and converting drafts into usable 3D curves and 2D panels. --- ## Introduction to the 3D Draft Pen Virtual Model Tool This section explains the purpose and capabilities of the 3D draft pen tool, designed to enable freehand drawing directly on virtual 3D models, seamlessly creating and previewing clothing outlines. - The 3D draft pen allows freehand sketching of lines on a virtual model, similar to drawing on paper. - Draft lines instantly transform into 3D curves fitted precisely to the model's surface. - Drawings can be converted directly into 2D garment panels with seam-to-seam accuracy. - This function provides a fast and intuitive workflow for clothing design without complex data calculations. --- ## Accessing and Setting Up the 3D Draft Pen Tool This section describes how to access the 3D draft pen tool within CLO 2026.0, including interface navigation and view adjustments. - Open the prepared virtual model in the 3D window. - On the left toolbar in the 3D window, long-press the 3D pen virtual model icon to reveal a menu. - Select the newly added "3D draft pen virtual model" tool. - After selection, a draft window appears in the upper left corner of the 2D window. - Note: The 3D draft window does **not** open in the 3D window but instead, the 3D view automatically switches to a front view optimized for drawing. - In this mode, rotation of the viewing angle is limited to maintain drawing accuracy, but you can freely position and balance the view. --- ## Drawing Lines on the Virtual Model This section provides instructions on how to draw smooth, natural lines on the virtual model surface using the 3D draft pen. - Ensure the drawing type is set to "Pen" in the draft window. - Press and hold the mouse button on the model surface, then drag to draw freehand lines. - The system performs real-time smoothing to make curves appear smooth and natural. - Pressing the Shift key while drawing enables easy creation of straight lines. --- ## Draft Window Functional Options: Symmetry, Guide, and 3D View This section covers key options within the draft window that enhance drawing precision and workflow efficiency. - **Symmetry**: Creates mirrored lines along the model’s center axis, ideal for symmetrical garments like jackets or dresses. - **Guide**: Previews how the draft will convert into 3D curves by showing control point bending, allowing adjustment of curve points if the shape is unsatisfactory. - **3D View Toggle**: Button at the bottom of the draft window toggles between front and back views, helping to complete the entire clothing outline effectively.

chunks.content: --- ## Draft Window Functional Options: Symmetry, Guide, and 3D View This section covers key options within the draft window that enhance drawing precision and workflow efficiency. - **Symmetry**: Creates mirrored lines along the model’s center axis, ideal for symmetrical garments like jackets or dresses. - **Guide**: Previews how the draft will convert into 3D curves by showing control point bending, allowing adjustment of curve points if the shape is unsatisfactory. - **3D View Toggle**: Button at the bottom of the draft window toggles between front and back views, helping to complete the entire clothing outline effectively. --- ## Step-by-Step Example: Drawing a Simple Dress Outline This section illustrates a practical workflow using the 3D draft pen tool to create a dress outline. - Enable Symmetry and Guide functions. - On the front view, draw the front chest line, side seam lines, waistline, and skirt outline smoothly. - Switch to the back view using the 3D view toggle. - Refer to the front outline to draw the back lines accurately. - Use the symmetry feature to ensure balance and consistency on both sides. --- ## Correcting Draft Lines: Wipe Function and Brush Size This section explains how to correct mistakes or unwanted parts of the draft using the wipe tool. - If a line is incorrect, click the line draft window and select the wipe icon at the top. - Adjust the brush size between 10 to 100 pixels for precise erasing. - The cursor changes to a double circle light; drag over lines to erase unwanted parts. - The wipe function only affects lines visible in the current view. --- ## Converting Draft Lines into Usable 3D Curves and 2D Panels This section outlines how to finalize the draft by converting it into editable 3D curves and subsequently generating 2D garment panels. - After completing the draft, click the "Convert to 3D pen" button at the bottom of the draft window. - The sketch instantly becomes a 3D curve accurately projected and fitted onto the model surface. - The system switches automatically to the 3D pen virtual model edit mode, allowing immediate adjustments. - Continuous lines drawn from front to back automatically merge into a continuous 3D shape. - Select the generated 3D lines and use the "Flatten as Panel" tool to create 2D clothing panels with correct seam-to-seam relationships in one step. --- ## Summary The 3D draft pen virtual model function in CLO 2026.0 revolutionizes garment design by enabling direct freehand sketching on virtual models, supported by real-time smoothing, symmetry, and guide functions. It streamlines the workflow from initial sketch to finalized 3D curves and 2D panels, eliminating complex calculations and accelerating creativity implementation. This tool is ideal for designers seeking speed, precision, and intuitive control over clothing outline creation.
